name: creative-process
description: The creative process in art from idea to exhibition. Covers five phases of creative work (inspiration, incubation, exploration, execution, reflection), sketchbook practice, artist statements, critique methodology (formal and conceptual), portfolio development, and the studio as a working environment. Use when guiding students through project development, facilitating critique sessions, developing artist statements, curating portfolios, or understanding how professional artists structure their creative practice.
